tasks.title: Operational authority, attestation and trusted time
tasks.original_scope: Provision real out-of-band evaluator/issuer authority, capture attestation, trusted clocks and revocation distribution.
required_closure_evidence: Independent review and issuer roles are enforced across adapters.
Expired/revoked evidence is invalid at assessment, issuance and serving time.
tasks.implemented_local: Public-key verification of independently configured Ed25519 identities, nonce-bound signed clock intervals and revocation status. Private SQLite replay/rollback watermarks, bounded sessions, disjoint authority roles, and an optional wrapper around the actual inherited publication/certificate verifier.
remaining: No live time/authority service, independent operator enrollment, KMS, hardware attestation, remote revocation distribution or trusted hardware clock was provisioned. Positive signed evidence is diagnostic.

The new wrapper is exercised but canonical/direct H7 publication callers are not migrated. Session freshness is bounded by explicit TTL, not instantaneous revocation polling. Local database state is not resistant to administrator rollback.

tasks.title: Operational rights inventory and output notices
tasks.original_scope: Bind real source/asset/provider/dependency inventories, scoped permission evidence and actual published notices.
required_closure_evidence: Unknown ownership/status or missing upstream permissions remains blocked/review-required.
Rendered credits and source offers match approved terms.
Qualified clearance is externally evidenced; synthetic permissions are never promoted.
tasks.implemented_local: Reuses the inherited rights evaluator over exact source/asset/dependency/provider inventory and independently signed clearance. Required notice channels are bound to exact output/capture bytes and observation types. The full trusted-time interval must fit permission validity.
remaining: No real ownership or legal clearance, live grant-status service, qualified external rights reviewer or native rendered/deployed notice validation was executed. Submitted capture assertions remain dependent on independently trustworthy capture evidence.
The saved Money.pdf is an analysis source, not a cleared distribution asset; its full bytes are deliberately excluded from this delivery.

tasks.title: Native real-book QA integration and EVAL handoff
tasks.original_scope: Implement a reproducible original-source-to-lesson/video/game QA harness with retained artifacts and deliberate failure injection; consume Section17 benchmarks when available.
required_closure_evidence: At least one actual source passage exercises native BI/KI/PR/MATH/RE/PED/DIR/VIS/ANI/COMP/AUDIO/GAME boundaries where applicable.
Source loss, wrong math, bad narration, broken control and repair regression are independently rejected.
Measured learning/benchmark/product acceptance is a separate downstream gate, not a prerequisite to writing this harness.
tasks.implemented_local: Authoritative 15-stage source-to-EVAL plan and registered, immutable-input stage execution with source/run/execution/check bindings and EVAL handoff. Actual saved Money.pdf passage executes preserved native BI region/provenance and native KI claim/evidence functions. A missing native executor blocks before any fallback execution.
remaining: Three complete protocol diagnostics used 45 authored Python/JSON stage processes, not native lesson/video/game generation. The real source executes BI and KI passage boundaries only; all 13 other stages are explicitly NOT_RUN.

Full canonical checkout, isolated native stage executors, genuine semantic/quality authorities, actual SceneIR/Remotion/AUDIO/GAME runs, independent seeded-defect controls on that path and real-book EVAL/product acceptance remain open.

tasks.title: Governed correction-memory evidence export
tasks.original_scope: Export rights-safe, source-bound failure/repair/assessment evidence for BIE improvement and reusable scene/code memory; do not silently train or mutate product memory.
required_closure_evidence: Stale/wrong corrections cannot poison future retrieval or erase provenance.
Reuse still reruns context-dependent quality gates.
Improvement claims require held-out comparison, not a growing archive count.
tasks.implemented_local: Explicit, separately approved correction export binds actual source, before/after text, validation bytes, rights and context. Targeted baseline failure and every candidate validation case are required. Reuse rereads current source bytes, rights and new context and requires fresh source/semantic/regression gates.
remaining: Only a synthetic correction/permission/approval diagnostic was exported. No product retrieval store was mutated, no model was trained and no empirical improvement is claimed.

Native correction-memory adoption, independent semantic assessment, genuine retrieval rights and held-out improvement comparisons remain required. A signed validation statement alone does not establish that its interpretation is true.
